description: Get instant, indicative conveyancing (property legal work) quotes from the OpenMoov solicitor panel for a UK purchase, sale or remortgage. Input the transaction type, property price in GBP and optionally tenure (freehold|leasehold — leasehold usually costs more) and the property postcode (firms can price by area). Returns up to 5 firms, matched on availability and case type (never ranked by price), with legal fees (inc VAT), disbursements and grand total in GBP. Quotes are indicative, not binding.

transaction_type.description: "purchase" when buying, "sale" when selling, "remortgage" when refinancing

name: instant_conveyancing_quote
title: Instant conveyancing quotes (UK)
